# agents { #mlsysim.agents }

`agents`

Authoritative registry of agent system profiles, execution harnesses, deliberation search architectures, and reference platforms.

## Classes & Registries

| Object | Type | Description |
|:---|:---|:---|
| [`Agents`](#mlsysim.agents.Agents) | `Registry` | Root registry grouping all agent subclasses (`Coding`, `Deliberation`, `MultiAgent`, `Interactive`, `Platforms`). |
| [`AgentPlatforms`](#mlsysim.agents.AgentPlatforms) | `ReferencePlatforms` | Canonical reference platforms binding compute nodes, models, and sandboxes. |
| [`AgentArchitecture`](#mlsysim.agents.AgentArchitecture) | `BaseModel` | Typed schema for agent execution harnesses, context boundaries, and sandbox metrics. |

## Sub-Registries

### `Agents.Coding` (`CodingAgents`)
- `SWE_Bench_Runner`: Reference SWE-bench coding harness hosted on `Systems.Nodes.HGX_H100_EPYC` with Firecracker microVM sandboxing (5 ms startup, 15 ms snapshot restore, 512 MiB footprint, 30 max steps).
- `SWE_Bench_Workstation`: Local unified-memory developer baseline hosted on `Systems.Nodes.Workstation_M3Max` paired with `Models.Language.Llama3_8B`.

### `Agents.Platforms` (`AgentPlatforms`)
- `Cloud_DGX_H100`: Enterprise cloud cluster execution envelope (SWE-bench harness on HGX H100 with dual 96-core EPYC CPUs and 8× H100 SXM5).
- `Workstation_Apple`: Local developer workstation envelope (SWE-bench harness on Apple M3 Max with 16 CPU cores and 128 GiB unified memory).

### `Agents.Deliberation` (`DeliberationAgents`)
- `TreeSearch`: Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) deliberation agent with 8 branches, 64k context window, and PRM verification.

### `Agents.MultiAgent` (`MultiAgents`)
- `SupervisorWorker`: Hierarchical multi-agent coordinator with 32k context window and coordination overhead parameter $\beta = 0.030$.

### `Agents.Interactive` (`InteractiveAgents`)
- `StreamingVoice`: Speech-to-speech conversational pipeline with 8k context window and real-time latency budget (TTFT $\le 200\text{ ms}$).

## Python Usage

```python
import mlsysim

# Access reference platforms
cloud_platform = mlsysim.AgentPlatforms.Cloud_DGX_H100
local_platform = mlsysim.AgentPlatforms.Workstation_Apple

# Inspect sandbox and host parameters
print(cloud_platform.serving_node.host_cpu)         # Dual AMD EPYC 9654
print(cloud_platform.serving_node.host_cpu_cores)   # 192
print(cloud_platform.sandbox_startup_latency)       # 5.0 ms
print(cloud_platform.sandbox_memory_footprint)      # 512 MiB
```
